'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe Phillips DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Phillips]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Who plays mistryl?
* '''Username:''' JosephPhillips
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
